recipe.name: Buttery Soft Dinner Rolls
directions: Combine all of the ingredients except the egg wash in a large mixing bowl or in the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the hook attachment. Mix the dough by hand or at low speed until it comes together.

If mixing by hand, turn the dough out onto a work surface once the dough becomes too difficult to mix with a spoon and knead until smooth, about 5 minutes. If using a mixer, knead the dough on low for 3 minutes more once it has come together.
Place the dough in an ungreased bowl, cover with plastic wrap and let rise at room temperature until doubled in size, about 45 minutes.
Rub the bottom and sides of 9 × 13-inch (22.5 × 32.5 cm) baking pan with an even layer of soft butter. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured work surface and divide into 24 equal pieces.
Shape the dough into balls and arrange them in the prepared pan. Cover with a tea towel and let rise at room temperature for 30 minutes.

Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Unwrap the rolls, brush with the egg wash and bake for about 25 minutes, until golden brown on top. Let them cool in the pan on a rack for 20 minutes, then serve warm, or transfer them to a wire rack to cool completely.

ingredients.name: Unsalted Butter
ingredients.notes: 60 g, at room temperature, plus extra for the pan

ingredients.name: Egg
ingredients.notes: whisked with 2 Tbsp (30 mL) water, for egg wash
